decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 4 - The brick planters shown on drawing number 1964/6, hereby approved, shall be provided before the additional accommodation, hereby approved, is occupied. The planters, having been provided, shall be retained permanently.

Condition : 5 - Reasons:
The proposal is for the conversion of the roof for a new bedroom with an ensuite, new dormer windows to the side and rear of the dwelling and the installation of a Velux window on the roof at the front elevation. The proposal also includes alterations to the first floor with modifications to an existing bedroom and construction of a new stair to the roof/loft. It is considered that the position, bulk, scale, materials and appearance of the proposed works would not result in any significant adverse impacts upon the amenity of the existing site, or the adjoining and neighbouring properties. The development is therefore in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, adopted December 2003.
description: Erection of side and rear roof extensions to the side and rear roof slopes, the insertion of a roof light to the front roof slope with a loft conversion to the house to create habitable rooms
